pages.title: The Highlands' own
text: Among the stone, moss and groves of the Highlands live a mountain ram, a boar, a man-o'-war that drifts on the wind, and a stone ape that comes out at night.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with its own food, named under **Hunting and herding** below. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though none of them has a familiar gift of its own.

pages.title: Cragcoat
text: A mountain ram in a heavy fleece, in herds of two to four. **30 health** and **7 armour**, and slow.
It drops **1 to 3 Crag Fleece**, more with Looting.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 Raw Game and up to 2 March Leather. Breed with **wheat**.

pages.title: Bouldersnout
text: A tusked boar with a hide like a rockfall, in herds of two to four. **30 health** and **4 armour**.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 Raw Game and up to 2 March Leather. Breed with **potatoes or carrots**.

pages.title: Updrifter
text: A sky man-o'-war, a glassy float under a magenta crest trailing stinging tentacles, that drifts over the slopes in ones to threes. **12 health**, no armour.
Hunted, it also drops up to 2 String. Breed with **Ley Thistle**.

pages.title: Scree Lurcher
text: A stone ape, slabs of rock on its back, that rises on the open ground at night, one to three at a time. It has **32 health** and **3 armour** and hits for **6**, and every blow shoves you back.
It drops **1 to 2 Scree Knuckles**, a Shove reagent.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 2 Flint and up to 2 Iron Nuggets.

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. Meat drops roasted if the animal died burning. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
